market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $150 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL front-month settle near ~$105 currently. $150 settlement would require +43% rally and a daily close at that level by end of June. Even with Iran tensions, an extreme outcome; analyst year-end ranges top out around $137.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Extreme geopolitical event in Middle East could spike futures, but settlement bar is high.
